audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra grain offering text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for grain/minhah offering, oil, frankincense, memorial portion, priestly portion, no leaven/honey, salt of covenant, firstfruits.

verses.restored: When a soul/life brings near grain offering to YHWH, his offering shall be fine flour; he shall pour oil upon it and put frankincense upon it.

familiar.text: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:

modern.text: “When anyone brings a grain offering to the LORD, his offering must consist of fine flour. He is to pour olive oil on it, put frankincense on it,

original.text: וְנֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי תַקְרִ֞יב קָרְבַּ֤ן מִנְחָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת יִהְיֶ֣ה קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ וְיָצַ֤ק עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְנָתַ֥ן עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָֽה

verses.restored: He shall bring it to sons of Aaron, the priests; he shall grasp from there full handful from its fine flour and oil with all its frankincense, and priest shall turn its memorial portion into smoke on altar, fire-offering, soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: And he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:

modern.text: and bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests. The priest shall take a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the frankincense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

original.text: וֶֽהֱבִיאָ֗הּ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹן֮ הַכֹּהֲנִים֒ וְקָמַ֨ץ מִשָּׁ֜ם מְלֹ֣א קֻמְצ֗וֹ מִסָּלְתָּהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: The remainder of grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons, Holy of Holies from fire-offerings of YHWH.

familiar.text: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

modern.text: The remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made by fire to the LORD.

original.text: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֨רֶת֙ מִן הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: When you bring near offering of grain offering baked in oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil or unleavened wafers spread with oil.

familiar.text: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

modern.text: Now if you bring an offering of grain baked in an oven, it must consist of fine flour, either unleavened cakes mixed with oil or unleavened wafers coated with oil.

original.text: וְכִ֥י תַקְרִ֛ב קָרְבַּ֥ן מִנְחָ֖ה מַאֲפֵ֣ה תַנּ֑וּר סֹ֣לֶת חַלּ֤וֹת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֥ים בַּשָּֽׁמֶן

verses.restored: If your offering is grain offering on griddle, it shall be fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened.

familiar.text: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.

modern.text: If your offering is a grain offering prepared on a griddle, it must be unleavened bread made of fine flour mixed with oil.

original.text: וְאִם מִנְחָ֥ה עַל הַֽמַּחֲבַ֖ת קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן מַצָּ֥ה תִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: Break it into pieces and pour oil upon it; it is grain offering.

familiar.text: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.

modern.text: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

original.text: פָּת֤וֹת אֹתָהּ֙ פִּתִּ֔ים וְיָצַקְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ שָׁ֑מֶן מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא

verses.restored: If your offering is grain offering in pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

familiar.text: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

modern.text: If your offering is a grain offering cooked in a pan, it must consist of fine flour with oil.

original.text: וְאִם מִנְחַ֥ת מַרְחֶ֖שֶׁת קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ סֹ֥לֶת בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן תֵּעָשֶֽׂה

verses.restored: You shall bring grain offering that is made of these to YHWH; it shall be brought near to priest, and he shall bring it to altar.

familiar.text: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.

modern.text: When you bring to the LORD the grain offering made in any of these ways, it is to be presented to the priest, and he shall take it to the altar.

original.text: וְהֵבֵאתָ֣ אֶת הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה מֵאֵ֖לֶּה לַיהוָ֑ה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ֙ אֶל הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִגִּישָׁ֖הּ אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ

verses.restored: The priest shall lift from grain offering its memorial portion and turn it into smoke on altar, fire-offering, soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

modern.text: The priest is to remove the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

original.text: וְהֵרִ֨ים הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִן הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֶת אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔הּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: The remainder of grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons, Holy of Holies from fire-offerings of YHWH.

familiar.text: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

modern.text: But the remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made by fire to the LORD.

original.text: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֨רֶת֙ מִן הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Every grain offering you bring near to YHWH shall not be made leavened, for any leaven or any honey you shall not turn into smoke as fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.

modern.text: No grain offering that you present to the LORD may be made with leaven, for you are not to burn any leaven or honey as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

original.text: כָּל הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּקְרִ֨יבוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א תֵעָשֶׂ֖ה חָמֵ֑ץ כִּ֤י כָל שְׂאֹר֙ וְכָל דְּבַ֔שׁ לֹֽא תַקְטִ֧ירוּ מִמֶּ֛נּוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: As offering of firstfruits you may bring them near to YHWH, but they shall not go up on altar for soothing scent.

familiar.text: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.

modern.text: You may bring them to the LORD as an offering of firstfruits, but they are not to be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma.

original.text: קָרְבַּ֥ן רֵאשִׁ֛ית תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהוָ֑ה וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לֹא יַעֲל֖וּ לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹֽחַ

verses.restored: Every offering of your grain offering you shall season with salt; you shall not let salt of covenant of your Divine be lacking from your grain offering. With all your offerings you shall bring near salt.

familiar.text: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

modern.text: And you shall season each of your grain offerings with salt. You must not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offering; you are to add salt to each of your offerings.

original.text: וְכָל קָרְבַּ֣ן מִנְחָתְךָ֮ בַּמֶּ֣לַח תִּמְלָח֒ וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֗ית מֶ֚לַח בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מֵעַ֖ל מִנְחָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ל כָּל קָרְבָּנְךָ֖ תַּקְרִ֥יב מֶֽלַח

verses.restored: If you bring near grain offering of firstfruits to YHWH, fresh ears roasted with fire, crushed grain of fresh grain, you shall bring near as grain offering of your firstfruits.

familiar.text: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.

modern.text: If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD, you shall offer crushed heads of new grain roasted on the fire.

original.text: וְאִם תַּקְרִ֛יב מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה אָבִ֞יב קָל֤וּי בָּאֵשׁ֙ גֶּ֣רֶשׂ כַּרְמֶ֔ל תַּקְרִ֕יב אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: You shall put oil upon it and place frankincense upon it; it is grain offering.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.

modern.text: And you are to put oil and frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.

original.text: וְנָתַתָּ֤ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָ֑ה מִנְחָ֖ה הִֽוא

verses.restored: The priest shall turn its memorial portion into smoke, from its crushed grain and from its oil, with all its frankincense; fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

modern.text: The priest shall then burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all its frankincense, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

original.text: וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָ֗הּ מִגִּרְשָׂהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה

translation_notes: Minhah/grain offering is non-animal offering and should be kept visible as valid near-bringing.
Memorial portion/azkarah rises while remainder feeds priests; offering includes shared provision.
Salt of covenant preserves durability/faithfulness symbolism.
Leaven/honey restriction is ritual-specific and not a blanket negative theology of sweetness or fermentation.
safety_note: Leviticus 2 prevents reducing sacrifice to animal blood. Grain, oil, fragrance, salt, and firstfruits are also holy modes of drawing near.
